{"consolidated_memory":"[2026-05-29 and 2026-05-30] cli/commands/deploy.py - Multiple instances of hang-on-exit in deploy command

PROBLEM (shared across both occasions):
Hang on exit in the deploy command. Symptom: a process that finishes work but never returns.
Reproduction: deploy the sample project and wait.
Component: cli/commands/deploy.py (developer tooling)
Stack: Python
Test coverage: tests/cli/test_deploy.py

OCCASION 1: [2026-05-29]
- Trigger: occurred only when two requests raced on the same key
- Root cause: a listener registered but never removed
- Fix: removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
- PR #3721 on branch fix/hang-on-exit-1
- Measured outcome: 64 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

OCCASION 2: [2026-05-30]
- Trigger: occurred only for accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Root cause: missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Fix: normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- PR #6975 on branch fix/hang-on-exit-2
- Measured outcome: throughput rose 13 percent, to 474 requests per second"}
